title: Design Engineering Graduate Program
content_text: Millar Merrigan Design Engineering Graduate Program. A structured 12-month pathway. Graduates build skills in drafting, design documentation, technical assessment, authority requirements and project coordination. As part of the Design team, graduates work on live projects with guidance from Design Engineers. Program includes mentoring, exposure to civil design, drafting, servicing, drainage, roads, sewer, water and infrastructure projects, practical use of AutoCAD, design documentation, checklists, authority requirements and quality processes. Key areas: drafting and documentation (AutoCAD, existing services, BYDA, engineering checklists), pre-permit and infill project design, drainage and servicing, major project drafting and design, stakeholder communication. Applications open and close Friday October 30th 2026, commencement early 2027. Submit current resume, university transcript(s), and a cover letter of up to 600 words to careers@millarmerrigan.com.au. Tertiary pathway in civil engineering design for land development.
apply_instructions: Email resume, university transcript(s) and cover letter (up to 600 words) to careers@millarmerrigan.com.au by Friday 30 October 2026. Commencement early 2027.

title: Undergraduate Engineers (Civil & Electrical)
abstract: Launch your engineering career on a major water infrastructure project in VIC. Gain hands-on civil or electrical project experience while studying
location: Healesville, Yarra Valley & High Country VIC
bullets: Family-owned business with strong values - you're more than just a number at BMD
Long-term career growth opportunity working with a supportive & experienced team
Access wellness programs, work-life balance initiatives, retail discounts & more
content_text:
About BMD
BMD is Australia's leading integrated engineering, construction and urban development business. As the largest privately owned civil contractor in Australia, BMD is at the forefront of excellence.
Over a 45-year history, BMD has grown to become a $2.5 billion operation, now sharing our expertise internationally in the Philippines and the UK.
About the Role
We’re looking for motivated Undergraduate Engineers (Civil & Electrical) to join our team on the Healesville Sewage Treatment Plant Upgrade project in Victoria.  This is an excellent opportunity for engineering students who have 1-2 years remaining in their degree or are expected to graduate in 2028, and are looking to gain practical, hands-on experience while continuing their studies.
Working alongside experienced project professionals, you'll be exposed to the delivery of critical water infrastructure and develop the technical, commercial, and leadership skills needed for a successful engineering career.
About the Project
The Healesville Sewer Treatment Plant Upgrade is a significant infrastructure project that will enhance essential water services for the community while supporting sustainable growth across the region.
What You’ll Be Doing
Reporting to experienced Project and Site Engineers, you'll have the opportunity to:
- Assist with project planning, coordination and delivery activities
- Support site-based construction and engineering teams
- Prepare and review quality documentation, inspections and reports
- Monitor project progress, costs, productivity and subcontractor performance
- Contribute to safety, environmental and quality compliance initiatives
- Coordinate procurement, materials and project documentation
- Participate in problem-solving and continuous improvement activities
About You
- Currently studying a Bachelor of Civil Engineering or Bachelor of Electrical Engineering
- Ideally in your penultimate or second-last year of study, with approximately 1-2 years remaining
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take initiative
- Ability to work collaboratively within a high-performing project team
- Strong organisational and problem-solving capabilities
- Valid driver’s licence (preferred)
What We Offer
- Real-world experience on major infrastructure projects
- Structured development and mentoring from industry leaders
- Inclusive, collaborative and supportive team culture
- Exposure to regional and community-focused projects
- Opportunity to build a long-term career with a leading contractor
Apply Now
If you’re passionate about building a career in construction & engineering and want to contribute to meaningful infrastructure projects across Victoria, we’d love to hear from you.
BMD recognise that we are strengthened by diversity, we value and support a culture where everyone feels included and respected. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.
For further details on what makes BMD unique, head to https://www.bmdgroup.global

title: Graduate Engineering Program 2027
abstract: Start your engineering journey with one of Australia's leading infrastructure providers and grow through real project experience.
bullets: Mentoring from experienced engineers and industry leaders
content_text:
Start your engineering journey with one of Australia's leading infrastructure providers and grow through real project experience.
At Downer Energy & Utilities, we are looking for motivated and ambitious Graduate Engineers to join our team and contribute to delivering critical infrastructure projects across Australia and New Zealand.
As a Graduate Engineer, you will participate in a structured graduate program, with the possibility of rotating across various business functions and project environments. You will gain valuable hands on experience supporting operational, financial, programming and administrative activities while working alongside experienced industry professionals.
This role offers the opportunity to build your technical capability, develop commercial awareness and strengthen stakeholder engagement skills while contributing to projects that power and connect communities. Flexibility and mobility are essential, as project based work may require travel and relocation throughout Australia and/ or New Zealand. 
What We're Looking For
- Degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Civil Engineering, completed in 2025 or due for completion by the end of 2026
- Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency
- Hold current driver's licence and availability to commence in February 2027
- A willingness to learn, an open mindset and a desire to build your professional career from the ground up
- Strong communication and relationship building skills
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- A collaborative approach and eagerness to learn from experienced professionals
- A proactive, self motivated attitude with a commitment to ongoing development
What We Offer
At Downer, we are committed to developing our people and providing meaningful career opportunities.
You will benefit from:
- Exposure to major infrastructure and utilities projects across Australia
- Mentoring and support from experienced industry professionals
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities
- Strong focus on safety, sustainability and innovation
- A supportive and collaborative team environment
- Competitive remuneration and employee benefits
- Opportunities for long term career growth within a leading infrastructure services provider 
About Energy & Utilities
Downer Energy & Utilities delivers end to end engineering, construction, maintenance and asset management services to customers across power, gas, water, telecommunications and renewable energy sectors. Our people work on some of Australia's most significant infrastructure projects, helping to build sustainable communities and support the nation's future energy needs.
At Downer, our success is driven by our people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, culturally diverse individuals and people with disabilities.
How to Apply
To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit your application online including your resume and a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.
We encourage applications from candidates who are passionate about building a career in the utilities and infrastructure sector and are committed to delivering safe and sustainable outcomes for our customers and communities.
Please note: Downer does not accept unsolicited resumes, fees or costs from recruitment agencies, search firms or third parties. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Downer or its employees will become the property of Downer and Downer will not be liable for any associated fees.
